description: Find the version to upgrade to for one npm package. Returns, per release line (major, or minor for 0.x), the version that fixes every known advisory of the last 120 days; a line still affected has safe: null and the ids that keep it affected. Also lists advisories with no fix found, and says whether this package name itself is flagged as malicious. Use it after get_advisories, to pick one target version per line.

package.description: One npm package name as written in package.json, for example "next" or "@solana/web3.js".

name: latest_safe
title: Safe version per release line
